description: This Java class `SchedulerJobHelper` provides utility methods to interact with scheduler jobs in the Fineract platform's integration tests. It includes methods for retrieving jobs, updating their status, executing them, and waiting for their completion, primarily used for testing scheduler-related functionality.

classes.name: SchedulerJobHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing and testing scheduler jobs within the Fineract integration test suite.

methods.name: executeAndAwaitJob
methods.description: Launches a Job and waits for its completion, identified by job name.

methods.name: executeAndAwaitJobByShortName
methods.description: Launches a Job identified by its short name and waits for its completion.

methods.name: fastForwardTime
methods.description: Advances the business date day-by-day while executing and waiting for a specific job.

methods.name: getSchedulerJobIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the jobId of a scheduler job given its display name.

methods.name: getSchedulerJobIdByShortName
methods.description: Retrieves the jobId of a scheduler job by its short name.

methods.name: updateSchedulerStatus
methods.description: Starts or stops the scheduler based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: updateSchedulerJob
methods.description: Updates the 'active' status of a specific scheduler job by job ID.

methods.name: runSchedulerJob
methods.description: Triggers execution of a scheduler job by ID and waits for its completion.

methods.name: runSchedulerJobByShortName
methods.description: Triggers execution of a scheduler job by short name and waits for its completion.

methods.name: getAllSchedulerJobs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all scheduler jobs with detailed info.

methods.name: getAllSchedulerJobIds
methods.description: Gets list of IDs of all scheduler jobs.

methods.name: getAllSchedulerJobNames
methods.description: Gets list of display names of all scheduler jobs.

methods.name: getSchedulerJobById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a scheduler job by ID.

methods.name: getSchedulerStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the scheduler is active or inactive.
